scope.purpose: Map exact open educational resources to educational stage, subject need, curricular role, rights, delivery and accessibility evidence.
scope.interpretation_rule: A resource may be educationally relevant while still being unusable as a translation master; curricular completeness, derivative rights, offline delivery and accessibility are independent fields.
